doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Manetta takes the West End job with Wade Whaley and Mutt Carey
summary: Walter Decou fetches Manetta to a bungalow job in West End, with Mutt Carey and Wade Whaley, while Ory explains a licence delay.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I'll tell you how it was. No, let me tell you how it was. I'll foreseeing and tell you how it was. Yes, go ahead. Well, after they backed out, I went out. I had the tickets in my pocket. My brothers, I'm so worried. I'm going to say, well, wait a while. I said, I promised to go out with the boy and I got the tickets. She said, well, wait a while. I'll wait a while. Well, on a Sunday morning, about 4 o'clock, 4.30 in the morning, who comes to my house, 3.31 L. Street, damn. Knocked me out that night. But Walter Deku. Walter Deku come to my house, chills and fever. Knocked on the door and my mother went to the door and offered him inside. So it was pretty sick and she said, oh, just tell me to come to the door. She said, come tell me. I'll go to the door and I said, look, oh, she said.
She won't bother anything. She won't bother anything. Let her play. I won't hurt anything.

Okay. All right. Go ahead now. So I says, all right, he's do favors for me. So I goes out to the bungalow at West End. And who they had out there, Walter Deku, well, I was playing this place a week. I take the job a week this place. Who they had out there but Mud Carey, Wade Whaley, and a little fella called Mack Hill stuck a bone on his feet. He died. The drum out there. Look at us out there. And I went there. So glad I came along because Wade used to buy music all the time and Walter Deku didn't read and he just played like he wanted. People liked it and he played that for years. Well, I never had nobody.

Well, I won it. And they throw it back to Sacramento, you see. Oh, yeah. And with a license of that kind, you can't, after 30 days, it's cancer. You can't use it, see. So it went back and it hit to the right because we couldn't get ready. You're all set to open the new place now. Yeah, he told me, go ahead. Well, I get it or not. We have the number, you know.
